root_cause: Functional/timing behavior is already correct: trace_mismatches/failing_suites are empty and return_code is 0; the failures are PPA-only (area 198158 vs 190000, power 0.0337 W vs 0.02 W). The dominant implementation defect is in rename_unit.sv: the checkpoint-save loop writes ckpt_map_nxt[alloc_slot][i] with a variable row index inside the big combinational block, so synthesis cannot infer constant-index per-row write enables and instead builds a wide 16-way write mux/decoder; this both inflates area and keeps the 16x32 checkpoint map toggling, consistent with the power regression after the prior area-focused patch. Row-decode the checkpoint write to constant-index rows and audit other variable-index writes. Secondary PPA headroom remains in the physical_register_file and load_store_unit large arrays/wide state, the rv32i5 top-level pipeline/debug fields, and ALU operand isolation.

All PPA edits must be equivalence-preserving: the teacher TB must remain PASS, with no change to architectural results, retire events, halt/exit_code, or debug protocol.

Fix rename_unit checkpoint-save by row-decoding writes to constant row indices; audit every variable-index write into unpacked 2D arrays in rename_unit. The FIFO->bitmap free-list refactor is already correct and must not be touched.

Add write/clock enables and operand isolation only where they cannot suppress a required write or alter single-cycle retire, ECALL halt, load-use stall, flush/epoch, cache request-hold, or ready/valid timing.
Do not remove fields needed for commit/retire/debug; only remove wide fields with no consumer.
